name: cash.credit_usage

list.description: Read native credit line usage and account member states.

purpose: Inspect source credit limits, used and available amounts without calculating or changing them.

fields.name: amount
fields.meaning: Native line limit; source representation and currency remain unchanged.

fields.name: usedAmount
fields.meaning: Source usage amount; never derived from limits.

fields.name: availableAmount
fields.meaning: Source available amount; never derived from usage.

fields.name: bankAccountCreditLineList
fields.meaning: Native account members; creditCurrency and currency describe distinct currency grains.

identity_description: Native string or integer id, preserving identity types; nested members use parent id and member id.
limitations: Fixed tenant GUAPW3SG, native GET with rowStart offsets and pageSize=100; no arbitrary filters or detail action.
Both outer count and result.count must agree; duplicate identities, changing totals and malformed envelopes fail.
Full native records retain unknown fields, null, empty text and exact amounts. Legacy whitelist field loss is corrected; no amount scaling, arithmetic or member aggregation.
Usage observation time is unknown; gmtModified and validity dates do not establish usage freshness.
Shared account flags are source values; no inferred limits or currency conversion.
